project_info.theme: Toyota financing puzzle for big plans and easy loan approval
project_info.color_palette: White, soft gray, dark blue, silver, black

main_subject.detail: A minimal financing poster with the Toyota logo top left and a large headline 'KE HOACH LON BAT DAU TU BUOC NHO'. In the middle, oversized pale-gray jigsaw puzzle pieces form a backdrop for a silver Toyota Innova Cross placed in front. The puzzle pieces contain financing messages: 'HAN MUC VAY DEN 85%', 'THOI HAN VAY LEN DEN 8 NAM', 'DUYET VAY NHANH CHONG', and on a separate hand-held puzzle piece 'HO SO DON GIAN'. Another left piece says 'KHOAN VAY'. A realistic hand at bottom right holds the final puzzle piece. Bottom-left script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Minimal finance-offer poster combining product render, puzzle metaphor, and clean white corporate space
